name: Downstem
description: A downstem is a critical component of a bong or water pipe—a tube that acts as a conduit to guide smoke or vapor from the bowl, down through the main chamber, and into the water for cooling and filtration. By submerging the smoke, it reduces the heat and filters out particulates, leading to a smoother, less harsh experience for the user.
